Notion is an all-in-one digital workspace that combines note-taking, databases, project management, documentation, calendars, and AI-powered productivity tools into a highly customizable platform. It supports relational databases, AI assistance, integrated documents, presentation views, and flexible planning boards that can be adapted for both personal and professional workflows. Its remarkable flexibility allows users to build anything from a simple note-taking system to a comprehensive company
